Migrate camellia statistics pages (#498)

## Summary
- migrate `statistics/summary-printer` and `statistics/version-analysis` into the new Woodii admin shell
- add dashboard-aligned hero/summary cards, app-aware query handling, and loading/empty states for both statistics pages
- add unified `b_node` data for the new frontend routes and analysis `/api/v1/chart/*` backend permissions

## Testing
- `cd woodii && npm exec --package=yarn@1.22.22 -- yarn run eslint src/views/statistics/summary-printer.vue src/views/statistics/version-analysis.vue -c .eslintrc.js --ext .vue`
- `cd woodii && npm exec --package=yarn@1.22.22 -- yarn build:stg`
- `cd woodii && npm exec --package=yarn@1.22.22 -- yarn typecheck` (fails on pre-existing repo-wide TypeScript issues outside DAM-31; filtering the output no longer shows any `src/views/statistics/*` errors after this change)

## Manual QA
- login to the camellia console with a role that can access statistics pages
- open `统计 / 打印机汇总`, switch app, search by SN/model/name, and verify the table/pagination render in the new shell
- open `统计 / 版本分析`, switch app/platform/version, and verify the list/pagination render in the new shell
